_description: Fired when a visitor clicks a link pointing at a different site
_note: Fired automatically by the client script when enableAutoLinkTracking is on. The _outboundClick tag is what the client resolves this name through, so renaming this event keeps auto-tracking working instead of silently sending a name the registry no longer has.
target_url_description: URL the link points to. Query parameters other than campaign ones (utm_*, gclid, ref and the like) and any #fragment are removed before storage
target_host_description: Hostname the link points to — group by this rather than target_url, which fragments one destination into one row per page linked to
link_text_description: Visible text of the clicked link, whitespace-collapsed and truncated. Empty string for a link containing only an image or icon
